name: loopseed
description: Minimal natural-language seeds for plan-bound, exploration-driven Codex loops.

interface.longDescription: Use a minimal natural-language goal to start an exploration, action, evidence, and recovery loop that escalates Codex mechanisms only when useful.
defaultPrompt: /goal $loopseed Follow the project's current plan and complete the active milestone with direct evidence.
$loopseed Complete this goal through the smallest evidence-driven loop; continue until verified or truly blocked.
